articles.title: Russian strikes kill nine in Ukraine and damage historic cathedral, officials say
articles.description: A Ukrainian drone attack in the Russian city of Tula, south of Moscow, killed three people and wounded three others.

articles.title: US kills leader of Venezuela's Tren de Aragua gang in air strike, Trump says
articles.description: Niño Guerrero was killed in a "swift and lethal kinetic strike," the US President wrote in a social media post.

articles.title: Leader of Venezuelan gang killed in US strike, Trump says
articles.description: President Donald Trump has said a "swift and lethal kinetic" US military strike has killed "the infamous leader" of Venezuela's Tren de Aragua street gang.

articles.title: Woman seriously injured in latest Australia shark attack
articles.description: A woman has been seriously injured in a shark attack off a Sydney beach in the fourth incident of its kind in recent weeks.
